summary: Complete fail-closed worktree observations, expose missing history coverage, and bound slow fleet snapshot collection

delivery.outcome: Fail closed on git status errors and missing worktrees with active leases (#150), and expose explicit unavailable history coverage and bounded fleet snapshot completeness (#153).
nonGoals: No actual worktree removal or deployment in this source slice
No silent broad recording or unrelated MCP session restarts

architecture.decision: Preserve unknown and unreleased ownership on missing or failed-status worktrees; report explicit unavailable coverage on empty history windows and attach completeness metadata to bounded fleet snapshots.
interfaceChanges: History coverage exposes explicit coverage_status/coverage_available/fleet_health_established fields and snapshot exposes completeness/deadline metadata.
architecture.rollback: Revert source through protected publication; never compensate by deleting worktrees.

validation.evidence: Unit and regression tests cover failed git status, missing worktree with active change-lease/v1, unavailable empty-window history coverage, and deadline-bounded partial/cached fleet snapshots.
